component: Nuxel v0.7.1-beta version pins and PWA server ownership repair
note: Live userspace delta for v0.7.1-beta: version pins, bridge/systemd environment updates, and the nuxel-web :8000 single-owner fix. No kernel, partition, modem or USB gadget mutation.
invariants: No write may resolve onto a raw partition block device, a BOOT/USERDATA/SYSTEM/RECOVERY/DTB/DTBO/VBMETA image, the radio/modem, EFS/SEC_EFS/calibration/IMEI/PIT or any partition metadata.
Every deploy target must live under an allowed userspace root (assert_userspace_path).
Stage -> verify SHA-256 -> atomic install -> restart the smallest affected service -> health check -> automatic rollback on failure.
Sources must resolve INSIDE this repository (no absolute path, no '..').

groups.component: v0.7.1-beta PWA version pins and launcher cache namespace
v0.7.1-beta bridge, notification and portal version pins
groups.declared_reload: systemctl daemon-reload && systemctl restart nuxel-bridge nuxel-http-bridge nuxel-notifications nuxel-portal
groups.health_check: grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-bridge.service && grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-http-bridge.service && grep -q '^Environment=.*NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-notifications.service && grep -q '"host_version": "0.7.1-beta"' /etc/nuxel/bridge-version.json && systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-bridge nuxel-http-bridge nuxel-notifications nuxel-portal && systemctl show nuxel-bridge.service -p Environment | grep -q 'NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta' && systemctl show nuxel-http-bridge.service -p Environment | grep -q 'NUXEL_BRIDGE_VERSION=0.7.1-beta'
groups.rollback: restore every <target>.nuxel-rollback; `systemctl daemon-reload`; restart nuxel-bridge nuxel-http-bridge nuxel-notifications nuxel-portal

groups.component: nuxel-web single-owner port and Wayland ordering repair
groups.health_check: grep -q 'FALLBACK_PORT=8001' /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-session.sh && grep -q 'After=.*nuxel-web.service' /etc/systemd/system/nuxel-wayland.service && systemctl show nuxel-wayland.service -p After | grep -q 'nuxel-web.service' && systemctl is-active --quiet nuxel-web
